name: 86 Chaos 17.0.26
label: 86 Chaos 17.0.26
notes: Adds a per-user English/Spanish interface preference with English fallback. The language choice follows the employee account and does not change the restaurant workspace for other employees.

Adds Phase 1 Spanish coverage for global navigation, Today/Manager Brief, Time Clock & Schedule, Schedule Builder primary controls, Request Off policy/workflow, Prep & Tasks, Settings preferences, and common dialog/navigation labels.
Keeps restaurant-entered content such as employee names, job roles, notes, recipes, menu data, event titles, and blackout reasons unchanged instead of machine-translating business data.

Adds a pure Node Phase 1 i18n regression suite and a deployed Playwright Spanish-interface test under the release-gate test universe. Existing Schedule Builder delete, delta-baseline, and Request Off regressions remain in the current-release targeted suite.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.26
summary: Introduces the first native bilingual English/Spanish interface foundation with release-gate coverage.
description: Adds a per-user i18n layer and Phase 1 Spanish translations across the most-used employee and scheduling surfaces without altering restaurant-entered data.
